[SWS_CM_10517] Failures in sending a SOME/IP trigger
Upstream requirements:
RS_CM_00204, RS_CM_00201, RS_SOMEIP_00004, RS_SOMEIP_-
00005, RS_CM_00004
⌈
If the sending of the
SOME/IP
trigger fails locally (due to a network error which is
notified to the
ara::com
implementation), the
ara::com
implementation shall return
ComErrc::kCommunicationFailure
in the Result of the
Send()
method of the
respective Trigger class (see [SWS_CM_00721]).
⌋
7.2.1.7 Handling Method Calls
